decisions.reason: As the flagship organic salami line that matches the firm's strategic direction, it costs little to keep while its value keeps resolving, so the option stays open.
The organic poultry mini snack still has its own page and fits the organic expansion, but the snack segment where Product C already failed raises its delisting risk, so it is kept under closer watch.
The organic boiled pork sausage was launched only in 2024 and is a low-cost extension of a staple category, so its prospects are still uncertain and keeping it open is cheap.
The thinly sliced organic chicken breast line opens a new format in the organic range, and one year is too short for its value to be revealed, so the option is retained.
The organic herb-coated salami sits close to the core and has its own page, but it may overlap with the organic salami platter, so it is kept while its results resolve.
